title: Shimmer button
description: A thin spark travels around a rounded button while the label stays still.
useCase: Give one occasional call to action a subtle idle highlight.
interaction: Click the button or pause the shimmer
reducedMotion: The border holds still; the button continues to toggle its local saved state.
limitations: Uses CSS container query units. The waitlist action is local preview feedback; connect your own handler.
look: Dark charcoal-green page with a single pill button in muted dark green, a soft inner highlight and a thin pale-green light on its edge.
motion: A blurred conic-gradient spark rotates once per 6 s with two holds while sliding across the button and back (3 s ease-in-out), lighting its 1 px edge.
adapt: The light is `.mg-shimmer-light` (a 90deg conic wedge on `mg-shimmer-spin`) inside `.mg-shimmer-spark` (sliding on `mg-shimmer-slide`); `.mg-shimmer-backdrop` at `inset:1px` hides all but the rim. Recolour `#dbedc8`, tune durations, and wire the waitlist `onClick` to your handler.
